caption: The drawing is a monochromatic (black and white) illustration on a cream-colored background, depicting a metal coffee pot with a wide, flared base, a tall, tapering body, a curved spout on the left, and a single, thick handle on the right. The pot has a fitted lid with a small knob on top. The surface of the pot is decorated with symmetrical floral and geometric patterns, including rosettes and bands of repetitive motifs. Surrounding the main depiction are several detail drawings on the bottom left: a stylized vase with flowers, a sun-like star design, a wavy chain motif, a chevron-like band, and a section showing the floral motif in detail. In the lower right section is a small schematic showing the pot's simplified outline with a measurement of "10 3/8" beside it. All illustrations are executed in fine, precise lines. The drawing is framed by a rectangular border, and there is a signature and number in the lower right corner, reading "James J. O'Mara 405594."
title: Pa. German Coffee Pot
